Digital signiert – Windows zeigt den Her: Digitally signed – Windows shows the publisher on launch.

Was jeder Agent meldet und wie oft, legs: Set here what each agent reports and how often – applies from its next run. “detected” means the machine has the role. Active Directory needs only one domain controller per domain.
Nur der Eintrag verschwindet. Ist der Ag: Only the entry disappears. If the agent is still installed, it reports again on its next run – uninstalling happens on the machine.
Noch kein Agent installiert. Agenten ers: No agent installed yet. Agents appear here after their first report.
Mit dem Token melden Agenten und Scripte: With the token, agents and scripts report data to this customer – only to the chosen site, and only until the expiry date. After creating it you can download agents and scripts with the token filled in; you see the token itself only once.
Gilt für die ganze Installation, nicht f: Applies to the whole installation, not to a single customer.
Alle installierten Agenten aller Kunden:: All installed agents of all customers: who reports, who is silent, whose runs fail and who still runs an old version.
Jedes angesehene oder kopierte Kennwort: Every password viewed or copied and every remote-support connection is in the activity log. The brake stops someone harvesting a list row by row.
Eine Handvoll Kennwörter nachzusehen ist: Looking up a handful of passwords is normal, a hundred in a minute is not. After that, wait a minute.
Wie weit die Auswertungen unter Statisti: How far back the reports under Statistics go. Older values are deleted at night.
Anfragen von Agenten und API-Token je St: Requests from agents and API tokens per hour and endpoint. One row per hour and endpoint – even a year stays small.
Der nächtliche Schnappschuss für System: The nightly snapshot for system and data growth – one row per day and figure.
Vorgaben für die Agenten aller Kunden. E: Defaults for the agents of all customers. Individual agents are set at the customer under “Agent”.
Wie oft ein Agent meldet, solange beim K: How often an agent reports unless set otherwise at the customer, and when it counts as silent.
Gilt für alle Agenten ohne eigenes Inter: Applies to all agents without their own interval – including those already installed, from their next request.
Danach steht der Agent auf dem Dashboard: After that the agent shows as “not reporting” on the dashboard, the agent page and under Statistics → Agents. Choose more than the longest interval, or an agent is silent between two reports.
Ein Agent-Token liegt auf jedem Rechner,: An agent token sits on every machine the agent runs on. A shorter validity limits how long a lost token is useful.
Vorschlag beim Erzeugen und die Laufzeit: Suggested when creating and used when renewing.
Ein späteres Ablaufdatum lässt sich beim: A later expiry date cannot be chosen when creating. Existing tokens keep their date.
Wie viel die Doku enthält und wie es wäc: How much the documentation contains and how it grows – in total and per customer. One value per day, taken every night.
Noch keine Werte – der erste kommt in de: No values yet – the first comes next night.
Der Verlauf entsteht ab jetzt – jede Nac: The history starts now – a value is added every night.

Die Sicherung von DokuVault selbst: Date: The backup of DokuVault itself: database and uploaded files. If it only lives on this server, it is gone with it – hence an external target as well.
Alte Sicherungen werden eine halbe Stund: Old backups are cleaned up half an hour before, by the rules below.
Ohne FTPS gehen Passwort und Sicherung u: Without FTPS, password and backup travel the network unencrypted. With an archive password (below) at least the backup itself is protected.
Erst alle Sicherungen, danach je eine pr: First all backups, then one per day, week and month. The newest is never deleted.
Verschlüsselt das ZIP der Sicherung und: Encrypts the backup ZIP and includes the .env with the key (APP_KEY). Without this password it cannot be restored – keep it safe, outside DokuVault.
Mail bei erfolgreicher und fehlgeschlage: Mail on successful and failed backups. Empty: no mail. Needs a configured mail server.
Ohne Archivpasswort kommt die .env nicht: Without an archive password the .env stays out of the ZIP. All stored passwords (servers, Wi-Fi, firewall, …) are encrypted with the APP_KEY and unreadable after a restore without it. Set an archive password or keep the APP_KEY from the .env separately, e.g. in a password manager.
Die ZIP enthält den Datenbank-Dump, alle: The ZIP contains the database dump, all uploaded files (storage/app) and the application; with an archive password also the .env. On a new server with PHP, MySQL/MariaDB and a web server:
Repository klonen, z. B. nach /var/www/d: Clone the repository, e.g. to /var/www/dokuvault, and download the backup.
.env zurücklegen – aus der Sicherung ode: Put the .env back – from the backup or a new one with the kept APP_KEY; adjust the database access for the new server.
Leere Datenbank anlegen und den Dump ein: Create an empty database and import the dump:
Anmelden und ein gespeichertes Passwort: Sign in and open a stored password – if it is readable, the APP_KEY matches.
Die Pfade in der ZIP folgen dem Installa: The paths in the ZIP follow the installation folder of the old server. Rehearse it once on a test VM before you need it.
Was die Installation gerade belegt und w: What the installation occupies right now and how it develops. If disk space gets tight or memory stays full, the server needs more resources.
Keine gemeldeten Backups. Backups ersche: No reported backups. Backups appear here as soon as an agent reports them (Veeam, Windows Server Backup, Proxmox).
Anmeldungen und Änderungen aus dem Proto: Sign-ins and changes from the activity log – as far back as the log keeps entries.
Anfragen an die Schnittstelle – von Agen: Requests to the API – from agents and API tokens. If the number rises or the answers get slower, the server needs more power.
Durchschnittliche Anfragen je Uhrzeit im: Average requests per hour of day in the chosen period – shows when the load comes.
Im gewählten Zeitraum gab es keine Anfra: There were no requests in the chosen period.
Feste Adresse im DHCP-Bereich. Kam sie p: Fixed address inside the DHCP range. If it came via DHCP, tick “via DHCP” on the address; otherwise an address conflict looms.
Verbindung in Ordnung: Datei geschrieben: Connection OK: file written, read and deleted again.
Datei geschrieben, aber nicht wieder les: File written, but not readable again.
Sicherung gestartet – sie erscheint in e: Backup started – it appears in the list in a few minutes.
Too many password fetches in a short time. Please wait a moment.
Läuft, aber ohne Archivpasswort – der AP: Running, but without an archive password – the APP_KEY is missing from the backup.
Running, but only on this server.
Das Muster muss mit einem Programm-Schem: The pattern must start with a program scheme, such as "mytool://".
Im Muster fehlt {id} — ohne die Kennung: The pattern lacks {id} — without the ID the button leads nowhere.
Aufgaben für :name gespeichert – gilt ab: Tasks for :name saved – applies from the next run.
:name meldet innerhalb der nächsten fünf: :name reports within the next five minutes.
Der Download ist nur kurz nach dem Erzeu: The download is only possible shortly after creating a token. Please create a new token.
PDF wird erstellt — der Stand steht auf: PDF is being created — the status is shown on this page.
Dienst für Windows-Server und -PCs, meld: Service for Windows servers and PCs, reports hourly
Auf den Rechner kopieren und doppelklick: Copy to the machine and double-click – address and token are already included. The service detects the machine's roles itself (server, domain controller, Hyper-V, workstation) and reports hourly; what it reports and how often you set here under “Installed agents” – where there is also “Report now”. The download is possible for 30 minutes and is as confidential as the token.
Was der Agent meldet, legst du nach der: What the agent reports you set under “Installed agents” after the first report. Suggestion instead of detection: -agents windows-server,windows-ad.
Intervall: auf dieser Seite unter „Insta: Interval: on this page under “Installed agents”; -interval 15 is only the suggestion for the first contact.

Protokoll: Ereignisanzeige (Quelle „Doku: Log: Event Viewer (source “DokuVault Agent”) and C:\ProgramData\DokuVault\agent.log. Under an “AllSigned” group policy the scripts do not run.
Einstellungen → Apps → „DokuVault Agent“: Settings → Apps → “DokuVault Agent” → Uninstall (or Control Panel → Programs and Features).
Entfernt Dienst, Konfiguration samt Toke: Removes service, configuration including token and the folder C:\ProgramData\DokuVault. Revoke the token in DokuVault afterwards.

Auf den Linux-Server (Debian/Ubuntu) kop: Copy to the Linux server (Debian/Ubuntu) and run as root – address and token are already included. The agent reports hardware, operating system, IP address and running services; a VM completes the entry the Proxmox or Hyper-V agent already created. For Proxmox hosts use the Proxmox agent.
